profile.headline: Software Engineer, ACM ICPC World Finalist 2018

positions.title: Software Engineer (Fullstack)
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Working on full-stack support for open-source Enterprise Resource Planning Software, specializing on inventory operations.
- Working on localization, performance and server configurations for clients worldwide.
- Languages: Python, Javascript, SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on projects tuning and implementing changes for complex services in ads delivery system
Optimized Resource Allocation for Ads Delivery, working with services to retrieve and rank ads.
- Worked on implementing new End to End Ads Delivery Redesign to optimize ad latency.
- The impact of the projects that I worked on is directly increasing Meta revenue and impressions around 0.3% in Facebook Mobile Feed and Instagram Feed.
- Languages: Python, C++, PHP, SQL
positions.insights: Skills: hack · Computer Science · Python (Programming Language) · Resource Allocation · Software Testing · SQL · C++ · Pandas (Software) · Software Design · Full-Stack Development · Programming · Software Development · Systems Engineering · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Expanded functionality of the Stars product to be used beyond videos. Extended a framework and created a tool to provide more reliability to the product performance by testing new eligibility rules
- The impact of the project was that the expansion of the product can continue where planned, as well as in more reliability for the product.
- Languages: PHP, Javascript (react)
positions.insights: Skills: hack · Computer Science · Software Testing · React.js · Web Development · Software Design · Full-Stack Development · Programming · PHP · Software Development · Systems Engineering · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created an internal web tool to be a one stop tool to manage and edit fields in ad requests.
- The impact of the project was that the tool will reduce the time Facebook employees will need to manage the fields in ad requests.
- Languages: PHP, Javascript (react)
